description: The open-web first pass captured 27 original Portuguese/English query actions and 477 ordered result headers, spanning broad and weekly-window searches, outlets, regions and labor/education/transport/public-service sectors. Results were noisy and included other periods, other countries, armed conflict and policy discussion; the count is not an event census or proof of absence.
required_followup: If later evidence or a priority review warrants it, extend contemporary provincial-outlet and archive coverage beyond the searched Maputo/Nampula and regional/sector probes.

description: Open-web search is not equivalent to the manual’s LexisNexis newspaper workflow. Search engines may omit local archives, ignore date filters, repeat syndicated stories, or surface later coverage; search-only headers cannot establish an event or absence.
required_followup: Compare any later review against accessible original/official materials and document the source and query coverage; do not describe this first pass as exhaustive.

description: All source cards saved in this pass remain search_only; no article body, archive page or report was opened. Dates, physical occurrence, demands, crowd size, state response, event endings and syndication/origin relationships therefore remain unverified. A failed local receipt-path gate is preserved as a no-request incident; it did not retrieve or authorize a body.
required_followup: Open only relevant, not-clearly-out-of-period sources after a fresh exact-URL receipt, full manual publisher/origin review and immediate complete input-path/hash recheck.

description: Searches used Portuguese and English. Local-language reporting and regional radio/print archives were not systematically searched or reviewed, including Emakhuwa/Makhuwa, Makonde, Sena, Changana/Changana-Ronga, Nyanja/Cinyanja and other relevant languages.
required_followup: Use relevant local spellings and regional-language archives with fluent review before relying on translated event facts.

description: No February 2021 lead was verified to establish a public gathering with at least 50 simultaneous participants. Search output includes workers, detainees, legal-assistance capacity and a later Pemba march; those counts or out-of-period figures do not establish an in-month crowd. The Sustenta snippet’s worker count is workforce context, not verified attendance.
required_followup: For any new February lead, seek event-specific evidence of actual simultaneous attendance and keep workers, vehicles, assisted persons and detainees separate from demonstrators.

description: Search results about curfew legality, police enforcement, political criticism, legal assistance, private-employer wage arrears and municipal labor actions do not establish a qualifying February public assembly or a demand directed to Mozambique’s own state/policy. The new search-only wage and Nampula youth-march leads need dates, gathering evidence and protesters’ own stated target before they can be assessed.
required_followup: If a qualifying assembly lead emerges, verify the protesters’ own stated demand and target from the event-specific source rather than inferring it from policy debate or labor subject matter.

description: No qualifying February-starting episode or continuation into February was established. The January dossier was consulted for the boundary only: it records a December 2020 transporter action and no established January continuation. The December source bodies were not reopened; no February continuation of that action was identified.
required_followup: Revisit boundary reporting only if new evidence identifies a concrete February occurrence; distinguish an organizer’s intention from an action and record any start/end uncertainty.

description: Prominent Cabo Delgado results concern insurgent attacks, armed clashes, insecurity, humanitarian access and displacement. They do not document protest assemblies, and affected/displaced population figures are not protest turnout.
required_followup: Keep conflict and displacement sources out of protest coding unless a separate source documents an actual public assembly meeting the inclusion rules.

description: The Q022–Q023 e-Global search lead describes police prohibiting a Nampula demonstration in a fuel-price search context, but the exact event date is not established from captured metadata. A search-only source card is now saved as MOZ21FEB_S026. Its relative publication age is not an event date, so it is not treated as February 2021.
required_followup: Do not treat this as a February 2021 candidate. If relevant to a later boundary review, establish the actual event date from a permitted, fully gated source.

description: The official Mass Mobilization baseline/version, definitive universe/country mapping and detailed current coding procedure remain unresolved. The provisional Mozambique code 541 and supplied protocol are not official assignments.
required_followup: Coordinator to reconcile this unit against the verified official baseline and coding procedure before any integration or final eligibility decision.

description: Publisher, syndication and written-origin independence could not be assessed because no source bodies or full provenance links were reviewed. Repeated search headers are not independent confirmation.
required_followup: When opening any relevant source, record the publisher, actual written-story origin, syndication relationship and scoped read evidence.

description: Searches Q025 and Q027 surfaced additional wage-action and march headlines: a Sustenta protest in Nampula, Gurúè municipal employees demonstrating over arrears, a Quelimane municipal-council strike, and an MDM criticism of police conduct during a Nampula youth march. The Sustenta search snippet mentions more than 200 extension officers, but this is not verified attendance at one public gathering. Captured results do not establish February dates, crowd size, or demonstrators’ own state-directed demands. The MDM result appeared at both non-AMP and /amp/ URLs; their body/origin relationship was not reviewed.
required_followup: If later date screening leaves a plausible February 2021 lead, review its exact URL only after a fresh receipt, full matching publisher/origin review and immediate complete input-path/hash recheck. Otherwise retain the uncertainty and do not infer an in-month event from the search query.
